body.en: A batch of 20 mandazi costs {4000}. In this sample market, a higher price can mean fewer sales. Try one batch.
body.sw: Kutengeneza mandazi 20 kunagharimu {4000}. Katika soko hili la mfano, bei kubwa inaweza kupunguza mauzo. Jaribu kiasi kimoja.

outcome.en: You sold 20 at {300}. You paid {4000} and received {6000}. More customers do not always mean more money left.
outcome.sw: Umeuza 20 kwa {300} kila moja. Umelipa {4000} na kupokea {6000}. Wateja wengi hawamaanishi pesa nyingi zaidi zinazobaki.

outcome.en: You sold 16 at {400}. You received {6400} after paying {4000}. Four unsold mandazi spoiled. Test demand before making more.
outcome.sw: Umeuza 16 kwa {400} kila moja. Umepokea {6400} baada ya kulipa {4000}. Mandazi manne yaliyobaki yameharibika. Chunguza mahitaji kabla ya kuongeza uzalishaji.

outcome.en: You sold 10 at {500}. You received {5000} after paying {4000}. Half the batch spoiled. A high margin per sale can still leave less money.
outcome.sw: Umeuza 10 kwa {500} kila moja. Umepokea {5000} baada ya kulipa {4000}. Nusu ya mandazi yameharibika. Faida kubwa kwa kila mauzo inaweza kuacha pesa chache.

body.en: You have ingredients for 12 more mandazi. Serving each customer takes time. What one change helps today?
body.sw: Una malighafi ya mandazi mengine 12. Kumhudumia kila mteja kunachukua muda. Mabadiliko gani moja yatasaidia leo?

outcome.en: Six sales brought {2400}; the batch cost {2400}. Working harder did not remove the serving limit.
outcome.sw: Mauzo sita yameleta {2400}; gharama ilikuwa {2400}. Kufanya kazi zaidi hakuondoa kikomo cha kuhudumia.

label.en: Pay a helper to pack orders

outcome.en: The helper cost {1000}. Twelve sales brought {4800}; ingredients cost {2400}. A clear task helped you serve more.
outcome.sw: Msaidizi amelipwa {1000}. Mauzo 12 yameleta {4800}; malighafi imegharimu {2400}. Kazi iliyo wazi imeongeza huduma.

outcome.en: You spent {4000} but could still serve only six people for {2400}. Production was not the limit.
outcome.sw: Umetumia {4000} lakini umeweza kuhudumia watu sita tu kwa {2400}. Uzalishaji haukuwa kikwazo.

body.en: The same flour costs {4000} now, or {4500} payable on day 5. Credit keeps cash available, but it must be repaid.
body.sw: Unga uleule ni {4000} sasa, au {4500} ukilipa siku ya 5. Mkopo unaacha fedha mkononi, lakini lazima ulipwe.

outcome.en: Cash fell by {4000}; you now hold flour worth {4000}. Buying stock is not the same as losing it.
outcome.sw: Fedha zimepungua kwa {4000}; sasa una unga wenye thamani ya {4000}. Kununua bidhaa si sawa na kuzipoteza.

outcome.en: You received flour worth {4000}, not cash. You owe {4500}. The extra {500} is the cost of waiting to pay.
outcome.sw: Umepokea unga wa {4000}, si fedha. Unadaiwa {4500}. Ziada ya {500} ni gharama ya kuchelewa kulipa.

body.en: Yesterday’s flour is worth {4000}. You expect a normal day. More stock ties up cash until a customer pays.
body.sw: Unga wa jana una thamani ya {4000}. Unatarajia siku ya kawaida. Bidhaa nyingi zinashikilia fedha hadi mteja alipe.

label.en: Use only the flour you have

outcome.en: You used all the flour and received {6000}. You kept cash free, but some customers left when you sold out.
outcome.sw: Umetumia unga wote na kupokea {6000}. Umeacha fedha huru, lakini baadhi ya wateja wameondoka bidhaa zilipoisha.

outcome.en: You paid {2000} more and sold the batch for {9000}. All the flour was used. This worked with today’s demand; it is not a rule for every day.
outcome.sw: Umeongeza {2000} na kuuza kwa {9000}. Unga wote umetumika. Hii imefaa kwa mahitaji ya leo; si kanuni ya kila siku.

label.en: Buy enough for a much larger day
label.sw: Nunua kwa siku yenye mauzo mengi

outcome.en: You paid {6000} more and received {10000}. You still hold unused flour worth {2000}. That value cannot pay a bill until you sell it.
outcome.sw: Umeongeza {6000} na kupokea {10000}. Bado una unga wa {2000}. Thamani hiyo haiwezi kulipa bili mpaka uuze.

title.en: What do you want to practise?

body.en: Both paths matter. This is your preference, not a test of your ability. You can explore every business later.
body.sw: Njia zote zina umuhimu. Hili ni chaguo lako, si kipimo cha uwezo wako. Unaweza kujaribu biashara zote baadaye.

outcome.en: A steady business needs reliable cash and time for the owner. The next days let you practise both.
outcome.sw: Biashara thabiti inahitaji fedha za uhakika na muda kwa mmiliki. Siku zinazofuata zitakupa mazoezi ya yote mawili.

label.en: Build a business that can run without you
label.sw: Jenga biashara inayoweza kuendeshwa bila wewe

outcome.en: A larger organisation needs capable people, clear tasks and checks. The next days let you try delegation and a customer order.
outcome.sw: Shirika kubwa linahitaji watu wenye uwezo, kazi zilizo wazi na ukaguzi. Siku zinazofuata utajaribu kukabidhi kazi na agizo la mteja.

body.en: These are invented one-day costs, not local wage rates. Pay for the work you need, then give the person a clear task.
body.sw: Hizi ni gharama za mfano za siku moja, si viwango vya mishahara vya eneo hili. Lipa kwa kazi unayohitaji, kisha toa kazi iliyo wazi.

outcome.en: You paid {1000}. This helper needs you to show the packing and checking steps.
outcome.sw: Umelipa {1000}. Msaidizi huyu anahitaji kuonyeshwa hatua za kufunga na kukagua.

outcome.en: You paid {2000}. Experience saves some training time, but you still need clear responsibilities.
outcome.sw: Umelipa {2000}. Uzoefu unapunguza muda wa mafunzo, lakini majukumu bado yanahitaji kuwa wazi.

title.en: Let the helper run the counter

body.en: You need time to speak to a buyer. A batch costs {2400}; twelve sales can bring {4800}. How will you hand over?
body.sw: Unahitaji muda wa kuzungumza na mnunuzi. Gharama ni {2400}; mauzo 12 yanaweza kuleta {4800}. Utakabidhi kazi vipi?

outcome.en: Only eight customers were served. Receipts were {3200}, costs {2400}. The helper still had to wait for you.
outcome.sw: Wateja wanane tu wamehudumiwa. Mapato ni {3200}, gharama {2400}. Msaidizi bado alikusubiri.

label.en: Agree the price, show the task, count cash together
label.sw: Kubalianeni bei, onyesha kazi, hesabu fedha pamoja

outcome.en: Twelve customers were served. Receipts were {4800}, costs {2400}. Clear authority and a cash check let you step away.
outcome.sw: Wateja 12 wamehudumiwa. Mapato ni {4800}, gharama {2400}. Mamlaka yaliyo wazi na ukaguzi wa fedha vimekuruhusu kuondoka.

outcome.en: Your helper’s preparation affected service. The cash record shows the result. Experience helps; a clear handover is still needed.
outcome.sw: Maandalizi ya msaidizi yameathiri huduma. Rekodi inaonyesha matokeo. Uzoefu unasaidia; maelekezo yaliyo wazi bado yanahitajika.

title.en: A shop asks for a trial batch

body.en: The batch costs {6000}. The buyer offers {9000}, payable after delivery. Negotiate a small paid trial or fund the full order?
body.sw: Gharama ni {6000}. Mnunuzi anatoa {9000}, kulipa baada ya kupokea. Ujadili jaribio dogo la kulipwa au ugharamie agizo lote?

label.sw: Endelea na wateja wako wa kawaida

outcome.en: You declined this order. You have no claim on the shop’s money and no delivery cost. Declining can protect working cash.
outcome.sw: Umekataa agizo hili. Hudai fedha za duka na huna gharama ya kupeleka. Kukataa kunaweza kulinda fedha za biashara.

label.en: Deliver the full batch on credit

outcome.en: You paid {6000} and the shop owes you {9000}. The sale increased what the business owns, but cash fell.
outcome.sw: Umelipa {6000} na unadai duka {9000}. Mauzo yameongeza mali ya biashara, lakini fedha zimepungua.

label.en: Agree a half-size trial, paid on delivery
label.sw: Kubali nusu ya bidhaa, malipo wakati wa kupokea

outcome.en: The buyer accepted the small trial. You paid {3000} and collected {4500}. A paid trial tested demand while limiting cash at risk.
outcome.sw: Mnunuzi amekubali jaribio dogo. Umelipa {3000} na kupokea {4500}. Jaribio la kulipwa limechunguza mahitaji na kupunguza fedha zilizo hatarini.

body.en: Rain has slowed walk-in sales. A small covered stall batch costs {2000} and brings {3000}. Choose how to respond.
body.sw: Mvua imepunguza wateja. Bidhaa chache chini ya kibanda zinagharimu {2000} na kuleta {3000}. Chagua hatua.

label.en: Make a small batch under cover
label.sw: Tengeneza kiasi kidogo chini ya kibanda

outcome.en: You spent {2000} and received {3000}. You adjusted production to today’s demand.
outcome.sw: Umetumia {2000} na kupokea {3000}. Umebadili uzalishaji kulingana na mahitaji ya leo.

outcome.en: You made no batch and received no sales cash. You avoided paying for food that might not sell.
outcome.sw: Hujatengeneza bidhaa wala kupokea fedha za mauzo. Umeepuka gharama ya chakula ambacho huenda kisiuzwe.

body.en: The shop owes {9000}. It offers {8500} now, or the full amount later. Cash tied up in a sale cannot buy flour.
body.sw: Unadai duka {9000}. Linatoa {8500} sasa, au kiasi chote baadaye. Fedha zilizo kwenye deni haziwezi kununua unga.

outcome.en: You collected {8500} and cleared the {9000} invoice. The {500} discount is a real cost of getting cash sooner.
outcome.sw: Umepokea {8500} na kumaliza ankara ya {9000}. Punguzo la {500} ni gharama ya kupata fedha mapema.

label.en: Keep the full invoice and wait

outcome.en: You still have a claim for {9000}, but no cash from this sale. There is no promise that it will arrive on time.
outcome.sw: Bado unadai {9000}, lakini hujapata fedha za mauzo haya. Hakuna uhakika wa kulipwa kwa wakati.

outcome.en: Cash rose by {4000}, but debt rose by {4400}. Borrowing is not sales income. The customer still owes you {9000}.
outcome.sw: Fedha zimeongezeka kwa {4000}, lakini deni limeongezeka kwa {4400}. Mkopo si mapato ya mauzo. Bado unamdai mteja {9000}.

body.en: Check the amount you owe below. Settle the flour credit and any short loan before choosing what to take home.
body.sw: Angalia deni lako hapa chini. Lipa mkopo wa unga na mkopo mfupi wowote kabla ya kuchagua fedha za nyumbani.

outcome.en: The record shows the cash used to repay debt. This is why borrowed cash was never free money. If you owed nothing, nothing was deducted.
outcome.sw: Rekodi inaonyesha fedha zilizotumika kulipa deni. Ndiyo maana fedha za mkopo si fedha za bure. Kama hukuwa na deni, hakuna kilichokatwa.

body.en: The next batch needs {4000} in cash. Check what would remain after taking money home. Family income and business cash serve different needs.
body.sw: Bidhaa zinazofuata zinahitaji fedha {4000}. Angalia kitakachobaki baada ya kuchukua fedha nyumbani. Kipato cha familia na fedha za biashara zina mahitaji tofauti.

outcome.en: You moved {6000} from business cash to the household. It is an owner withdrawal, not a production cost.
outcome.sw: Umehamisha {6000} kutoka biashara kwenda nyumbani. Hizi ni fedha alizochukua mmiliki, si gharama ya uzalishaji.

outcome.en: You moved {2000} home and kept the rest available for the stall. A cash reserve helps only if you know the next costs.
outcome.sw: Umehamisha {2000} nyumbani na kuacha zilizobaki kwa kibanda. Akiba husaidia ukijua gharama zinazofuata.

label.en: Keep the cash in the stall

outcome.en: Cash stayed where it was. Keeping money in the business does not create more money; you still need a useful way to use it.
outcome.sw: Fedha zimebaki zilipokuwa. Kuacha fedha kwenye biashara hakuzalishi fedha zaidi; bado unahitaji matumizi yenye manufaa.

body.en: Practise with a separate example: opening cash {10000}, cash received {6000}, cash paid {4000}. How much is left? This does not change your stall cash.
body.sw: Fanya mazoezi kwa mfano tofauti: fedha za mwanzo {10000}, fedha zilizopokelewa {6000}, fedha zilizolipwa {4000}. Zimebaki kiasi gani? Hii haibadili fedha za kibanda.

outcome.en: Yes: {10000} + {6000} − {4000} = {12000}. Record both money in and money out.
outcome.sw: Ndiyo: {10000} + {6000} − {4000} = {12000}. Andika fedha zilizoingia na zilizotoka.

outcome.en: That includes the receipts but misses the payment. {10000} + {6000} − {4000} = {12000}.
outcome.sw: Hizo zinajumuisha mapokezi lakini si malipo. {10000} + {6000} − {4000} = {12000}.

outcome.en: That leaves out the opening money or receipts. Start with {10000}, add {6000}, subtract {4000}: {12000}.
outcome.sw: Hizo zimeacha fedha za mwanzo au mapokezi. Anza na {10000}, ongeza {6000}, toa {4000}: {12000}.

body.en: Optional: what small paid trial could you try, or which cash entry will you record? Do not add names or private customer details. A note is a plan, not proof that you did it.
body.sw: Si lazima: unaweza kujaribu mauzo gani madogo ya kulipwa, au utaandika fedha gani? Usiweke majina au taarifa binafsi za wateja. Maandishi haya ni mpango, si uthibitisho wa utekelezaji.

subtitle.sw: Siku tano za mfano · bila kipima muda

sample.en: Sample only. Prices and Kiswahili need local review.
sample.sw: Mfano tu. Bei na Kiswahili vinahitaji uhakiki wa eneo hili.

net.en: Cash + flour + customer debts − what you owe
net.sw: Fedha + unga + madeni ya wateja − madeni yako

limit.en: This record shows choices in a sample game. It does not prove real business performance or qualify you for a grant.
limit.sw: Rekodi hii inaonyesha chaguo kwenye mchezo wa mfano. Haithibitishi matokeo ya biashara halisi wala kukupa sifa za ruzuku.

saved.en: Saved on this device. Nothing sent.
saved.sw: Imehifadhiwa kwenye kifaa hiki. Hakuna kilichotumwa.

failed.en: Could not save. Keep this page open, download your record, then retry.
failed.sw: Haijahifadhiwa. Acha ukurasa wazi, pakua rekodi yako, kisha jaribu tena.

confirm.en: Download your record first if you want to keep it. Replace this introduction attempt? Full-game records stay unchanged.
confirm.sw: Pakua rekodi yako kwanza ikiwa unataka kuihifadhi. Ubadilishe jaribio hili la utangulizi? Rekodi za mchezo kamili hazitabadilika.

previous.en: Your older introduction save is kept. This revised game starts a separate attempt.
previous.sw: Hifadhi yako ya zamani ipo. Mchezo uliorekebishwa unaanza jaribio tofauti.

invalid.en: This save cannot be opened. Download it before starting a new attempt.
invalid.sw: Hifadhi hii haiwezi kufunguliwa. Ipakue kabla ya kuanza jaribio jipya.

error.en: Could not open the game. Reconnect and reload.
error.sw: Mchezo haujafunguka. Unganisha intaneti na ujaribu tena.

online.sw: Nakala ya kucheza bila intaneti haijawa tayari

learn.en: Try the bakery next: organise production and people. Or choose any chapter.
learn.sw: Jaribu bakery: panga uzalishaji na watu. Au chagua sura yoyote.

steady.en: Try the stall chapter next: practise steady cash and income. Or choose any chapter.
steady.sw: Jaribu sura ya kibanda: fanya mazoezi ya fedha na kipato thabiti. Au chagua sura yoyote.

unavailable.en: Not enough cash for this choice

conflict.en: This attempt changed in another tab. Download this record, then reload to use the saved attempt.
conflict.sw: Jaribio hili limebadilika kwenye kichupo kingine. Pakua rekodi hii, kisha fungua tena ili kutumia jaribio lililohifadhiwa.

offlineFile.en: Download this introduction for offline use
offlineFile.sw: Pakua utangulizi huu kwa matumizi bila intaneti

cashWarning.en: Cash is below {4000}, the cost of the next batch. Try a smaller batch or collect payment before buying.
cashWarning.sw: Fedha ni chini ya {4000}, gharama ya bidhaa zinazofuata. Tengeneza kiasi kidogo au kusanya malipo kabla ya kununua.
